task: First paid GPU invocation of assistant-llm-v2
result: vLLM never served a request. --enable-sleep-mode switches vLLM onto the cumem allocator, which invalidates its memory profiling: it sized a 13.77 GiB KV cache then died with CUDA Error: out of memory at cumem_allocator.cpp:163, reporting 24.29 GiB allocated by PyTorch on a 22.06 GiB card. Container exited code 1 after 212.2s; Modal restarted it, and the retry was stopped with modal app stop -y. Roughly 6 A10 container-minutes spent for no measurement. No snapshot created, no cold-start number exists. Confirmed working for the first time: the snapshot machinery engaged (Creating GPU memory snapshot for Function), the bounded readiness wait reported the exit code instead of hanging, proxy auth accepted Modal-Key/Modal-Secret on a .modal.run endpoint, and max_containers=1 held.
